why: No source document gives Thai wording for the new rows, and writing a translation would be inventing a value that the glossary is meant to fix once.

text: The origin tag names the legacy story key and the criterion number only, unchanged, and is repeated word for word in every new story that carries the criterion.
why: Section R7.2 section 7 fixes one tag form; adding a service qualifier would create a second form and a second way to read the same criterion.

text: A contract fake is called 'the <service> contract fake', is versioned with the contract it fakes, and is published beside that contract in the Service Contract Catalog v1.
why: DP-11 requires a mock for every REST contract and section 12.8 requires the fake to be listed, but no source names the artefact.
read: Section R5.4 class C; section R5.5 DP-11; section R7.2 section 12.8; Arch v5 text extract

impact: A class C story can be built and accepted before the other service publishes, which is the point of the class C dependency; the fake must exist for that story to be Done.

text: The -ITG copy is a separate test case row at Level Integration or End to end; the plain ID stays on the unit, component and contract copy.
why: Section R7.2 section 16 calls it a copy and fixes only the suffix, so the original ID cannot be taken away from the original test case.
